review_round_01.audit_and_identity: The storefront accepts releases from the production audit envelope, also tolerates wrapped payload.releases data, and matches version tags with the producer's two-or-three numeric-component normalization. Source and provenance lookup use the serialized display name, so Python casefold keys cannot cause JavaScript lower-case guessing for names such as Straße.
review_round_01.accessibility_and_resilience: Unknown or missing storefront metadata never reads as official. Setup and detail dialogs each announce value-specific clipboard success or failure. The textarea fallback restores the original focused control, and detail close resolves the replacement trigger after optional metadata or audit data rerenders cards.
review_round_01.surface_and_gate: Status assertions now measure centered content groups; cards use an unclipped in-card focus ring; the narrow header shows Decky Plugins and hides optional links; and the mobile catalog heading gap is 8px. Playwright Chromium is cached under ignored .playwright-browsers, with an ignored Fedora runtime-library fallback when host libraries are unavailable. The hook runs pytest in local POSIX /var/tmp because the synced repository filesystem cannot represent the scanner test's chmod-denied cache case.

review_round_02.identity: The prior identity fix remains covered: browser provenance uses the producer-published exact catalog names instead of recreating Python casefold behavior, and audit matching uses a separate case-preserving tag normalization path. Node regressions cover ordinary case differences, Straße, and case-distinct audit tags.
review_round_02.version_history: The detail dialog now renders every normalized catalog version in a semantic Version, Released, Downloads, Updates, and Source table. Per-version counters preserve zero. One exact provenance record becomes a source link; absent metadata is labelled Official catalog; ambiguous or malformed source data never receives that fallback. The table has no Audit column and scrolls inside its own narrow-screen container.
review_round_02.verification: The final orchestration quality hook passed: actionlint and all three mutation controls, Ruff check/format, Node 14/14, Playwright 7/7, pytest 1104 passed plus 66 subtests, and review-note deletion validation.
